_readme: Operator POWER-PLAY species marks (conflict-lane rulings). Program record:
docs/power_play_program_2026-08.md (ruling c029555, 2026-08-14: Power Plays
are wanted setups).
Canonical DOUBLE-DUTY artifact: every ruled mark serves BOTH consumers -
the species census / ruling loop (keep/junk boundary evidence) AND the
segment_trends trend-state calibration (each dated trend_end IS one of the
owed trend-end labels). Both consumers load it through
tools.marks_json.load_marks_json and stamp the fingerprint of EXACTLY the
set they scored (tools.marks_json.marks_json_fingerprint); neither
re-implements loading (EC-13).
Deliberately OUTSIDE docs/marks/ (the sealed must-fire corpus): these are
CALIBRATION ground truth, UNCERTIFIED until the operator graduates a mark
explicitly, per-mark (EC-9's one-way human-gated graduation). Graduation
migrates the mark under docs/marks/ (the refuse_sealed_output-guarded
home) in a declared change; until then NO mark in this file may back a
pytest assertion. Same immutability discipline as its siblings
(docs/trend_end_marks_2026-08.json, docs/phase_c_marks_2026-07.json):
APPEND-ONLY, operator corrections only, and a failing case is fixed in
the ENGINE - never by editing a mark, widening a date window, or
reinterpreting a ruling (EC-7).
No tool has a write path into this file - it is hand-curated during
operator ruling sessions. Bulk sheet verdicts land in the editable DB
population (the read_verdicts discipline), never here.
Field glossary per mark:
ticker / source / as_of  - identity (source 'operator'; as_of = the
session the ruling was given, ISO)
origin                   - ruling-sheet | tradingview-screenshot | chat
verdict                  - keep | junk (the species boundary call);
absent = mark carries dates but no verdict
trend_end / ar / climax / breakout - ISO dates. Operator dates arrive in
European DD/MM form and are resolved to ISO
at transcription; record the resolution in
the ruling text when ambiguous.
root_swing_span / lps_span - [start, end] ISO pairs
ruling                   - the operator's words, verbatim
certified                - true ONLY after per-mark operator graduation
(absent means uncertified)
